name: Tom Anderson

bio.statement: The City of Tigard announced in December 2025 the appointment of Tom Anderson to the Tigard City Council, with a term from Jan. 1 to Dec. 31, 2026.
bio.excerpt: The City of Tigard is pleased to announce the appointment of Tom Anderson to the Tigard City Council.
